status: registered before any v7 episode is scored; freeze7.json holds the digests of this file, run7.py and its dependency run6.py before the v7 run
motivation_from_v6: v6 (log/20261008/README.md) measured that the independence-assumption two-class Gaussian LLR at threshold log(20) is NOT a valid e-process on this task: conditional wrong 0.40-0.45 across all realistic arms (nominal 0.05), shuffled decide-true 0.173, and 43.4 percent wrong even for the label-blind reading oracle - the statistic, not the acquisition, binds. The labelled post-hoc diagnostic localised two mechanisms: (M1) heavy-tailed residuals (median max |z| = 7.7 against the compound's OWN class template; 61.5 percent of compounds above 6), which let single readings produce threshold-crossing increments; (M2) cross-line correlation of class-template residuals (mean |rho| = 0.492 over 1996 sampled pairs), which overcounts evidence across lines. v7 attacks exactly M1 and M2 with three registered statistic families, keeping the dual core unchanged: the agent owns acquisition and stopping; the virtual cell (world5b) guides acquisition only.
task: Unchanged from protocol6: two-class nearest-rival contrast on the frozen pack; budget 16; QC-charge rule; abstention honest; fixed a-priori thresholds +/- log(1/alpha), alpha = 0.05; no calibration anywhere.

S_huber.definition: Per-line Huber-robust likelihood ratio increment: q_c(a) = max(phi((a - m_c)/s_c)/s_c, phi(Z_C)/s_c) with Z_C = 2.0 (the Gaussian density floored at its |z| = 2 value); increment = log q_1(a) - log q_2(a), bounded by z_c^2/2 + |log(s1/s2)| per line. LLR accumulates as in v6.
S_huber.theory: The floored density is the Huber (1965) least-favourable-distribution construction: the clipped LR is the exact LR of the robustified LFD pair, hence a nonnegative supermartingale under the epsilon-contamination neighbourhood of each template class, valid at arbitrary stopping times and under arbitrary predictable acquisition (Saha and Ramdas, IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 2024, arXiv:2408.14015, verified by retrieval 2026-10-08). The contamination level implied by Z_C = 2 is registered as a design constant, not fitted.
S_huber.registered_limitations: Cross-line correlation (M2) is NOT modelled by S_huber; per-line increments are still multiplied as if independent. Empirical Type-I is measured (shuffled + held-out, CP UCBs) exactly as in v6.

S_corr.definition: Joint multivariate-Gaussian LR over the purchased set J: term_c = -0.5 z_c' R_J^-1 z_c - sum(log s_c(J)) - 0.5 log|R_J|, with z_c = clip((a - m_c)/s_c, -3, 3); R is the shrunk pooled residual correlation of the TRAINING fold: pairwise-complete correlations of winsorized template residuals, shrunk toward identity with delta = 0.3, eigenvalues floored at 1e-3. LR = term_1 - term_2 recomputed after each purchase.
S_corr.theory: If the joint Gaussian with correlation R were the true conditional law, the marginal LR over the purchased set would be a martingale under the null for any predictable purchase sequence (the sequential-marginal LR identity). R is FIXED per fold from training residuals only (not adapted), so it does not break predictability.
S_corr.registered_limitations: z-clipping breaks the exact martingale (bounded-influence approximation); a pooled R ignores class-specific correlation (data-thin per class); R estimation error is not propagated. All three are registered; validity is empirical.

S_bet.role: assumption-light candidate (registered v6 next-direction (i)); attacks both M1 and M2 mechanically
S_bet.definition: Bounded betting e-process: b_j = tanh(Delta_j / 2) where Delta_j is the S_huber increment; E+_t = prod(1 + lambda_t b_t) with lambda_1 = 0.5 and lambda_t = clip(2 * mean(b_1..t-1), 0, 0.9) predictable from in-episode history. Decide h* at E+ >= 1/alpha; the symmetric process E- (lambda on -b) decides h_r.
S_bet.theory: Betting e-processes for bounded outcomes (Waudby-Smith and Ramdas, JRSS B 86(1):1-27, 2024, verified by retrieval 2026-10-08): (1 + lambda b) with |b| <= 1 is an e-variable whenever E[b | history] <= 0 under the null. The sign condition replaces the distribution assumption: it can hold under correlation and heavy tails where the Gaussian LR fails.
S_bet.registered_limitations: The sign condition E[b|null] <= 0 is itself model-dependent (which class is 'null' is unknown in the symmetric task); S_bet is registered as a heuristic e-process whose validity is measured, not assumed.

acquisition_and_dual_core.note: All rules predictable; the agent owns acquisition and the fixed e-threshold stopping; the virtual cell (world5b, holdout blend, per-fold rank/weight by the frozen machinery) enters ONLY as the acquisition guide in *_world arms (belief-expected |increment| quadrature as in v6, with the S_huber increment for huber arms and the per-line Gaussian increment otherwise). The world never enters any statistic: v6 measured its conditional channel as non-contributing (masked within noise), and v7 keeps the statistic world-free by design.
acquisition_and_dual_core.ceiling: oracle_reading on S_huber: label-blind, sees realised readings, buys the line with the largest realised |Huber increment| (a per-line-greedy ceiling on acquisition, registered as such; NOT a joint-greedy ceiling)

arms.imported_comparator: v6 frozen outputs (marg_fixed, world_world) for cross-run contrasts only

metrics: conditional wrong rate with CP one-sided UCB95 (primary validity number)
coverage (decided fraction) and certified-correct decisions per measurement (efficiency)
shuffled decide-true rate (empirical Type-I under label-breaking)
unit-cluster bootstrap intervals on all contrasts

gate_v7.G1_validity: huber_world AND corr_world BOTH: conditional wrong <= 0.05, CP UCB95 <= 0.10, shuffled decide-true <= 0.10 (validity must not depend on the statistic family chosen from the registered valid set)
gate_v7.G2_dual_core: coverage(huber_world) - coverage(huber_random) > 0 with the bootstrap interval excluding 0 (the virtual cell steers acquisition usefully where the statistic is valid)
gate_v7.G3_efficiency: certified-correct decisions per measurement of huber_world >= that of v6's marg_fixed (cross-run against the frozen v6 episodes; the valid statistic must not pay an efficiency penalty below the invalid v6 baseline)
gate_v7.interpretation: G1 is the scientific gate. If S_huber passes G1 but S_corr does not, M1 (tails) was the binding mechanism and correlation modelling is deprioritised; the reverse points to M2; both failing retires the e-process reformulation on this task family and reopens the register; both passing promotes the statistic family to the framework's decision-mechanism register as a PROPOSED contract (src/ promotion still requires the separate behaviour-verification discipline).
